context: A uni student gives life advice to his teen friend
purpose: Teach: そこら/やって来/づらい/いちいち/ごとく/馴染み/飛び出し/目覚め

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ蓮にいちゃん、最近朝の目覚めが最悪でさ、学校行きづらいんだよね。
lines.en: Hey Ren, my mornings have been awful lately, it's hard to go to school.
lines.style: Whiny teen voice, slightly dragging her words

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ああ、その気持ち分かるよ。俺も高校の時、毎朝鬼のごとく重い気分で家を飛び出してたわ。
lines.en: Yeah, I get that. In high school I bolted out of the house every morning feeling like death.
lines.style: Casual older brother tone, warm and a bit nostalgic

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 親もいちいちうるさいし、もうそこら中の大人が説教してくる感じ。
lines.en: My parents nag about every little thing, feels like every adult around me is lecturing me.
lines.style: Frustrated, venting quickly with teenage exasperation

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 分かる、分かる。でもさ、いつかその「お馴染みの説教」が懐かしくなる日がやって来るんだよ、マジで。
lines.en: I hear you. But seriously, one day you'll actually miss those familiar lectures.
lines.style: Gentle and reflective, smiling slightly as he shares wisdom

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うそだー。蓮にいちゃんも昔そんなこと言われて納得してなかったでしょ?
lines.en: No way. You didn't buy that line back when people told you, did you?
lines.style: Teasing, skeptical, half-laughing at her brother

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: まあな。でも一人暮らし始めた瞬間に目覚めたっていうか、親のありがたみがガツンと来た。
lines.en: Fair. But the moment I started living alone, something clicked and I really felt how much my parents do.
lines.style: Honest confession, slowing down on the key insight

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ふーん…まあ、ちょっとだけ聞いとく。にいちゃんの話、いつもより聞きづらくないし。
lines.en: Hmm... okay, I'll listen a little. Your advice isn't as hard to swallow as usual.
lines.style: Pretending to be uninterested but secretly grateful inside

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: おっ、素直じゃん。今日は晩飯おごるから、また何かあったら言えよ。
lines.en: Oh, look who's being honest. I'll buy you dinner tonight, so tell me whenever something's up.
lines.style: Pleased, warm, ending on a supportive big-brother note
